result.summary: ISS-0112 fix verified - secret_ref column issue resolved. Migration 1134 successfully added secret_ref and secret_key_id columns to webhook_subscriptions in tenant schemas. No column missing errors detected. Integration test suite has 137 failures, but all are unrelated pre-existing issues requiring separate WF-03 workflows (SQL type-cast asymmetry, test isolation violations, FK constraints, migration file lookups).

issues.description: ISS-0112 specific verification: PASS - No secret_ref column missing errors found in integration test output. The original ISS-0112 symptom is resolved.
